It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Rear camera - Watching your back!  The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe. Rear collision mitigation - It has your back.  Rear collision mitigation uses sensors to monitor the area behind you. description: Bergen County drivers know value when they see it, and this 2019 Nissan Sentra SV at Riverside Nissan in Hackensack delivers it in a sharp Scarlet Ember Tintcoat finish that stands out from the crowd. Whether you are commuting along Route 4, navigating I-95, or heading home through Paramus or Teaneck, this front-wheel-drive sedan with a smooth CVT with Xtronic transmission is built for everyday Bergen County life.  Step inside and you are greeted by premium cloth seat trim in charcoal that elevates the cabin above the standard Sentra experience. Front dual zone automatic temperature control keeps every passenger comfortable, while the 6-way adjustable driver's seat lets you dial in your ideal position for the long haul. Rear USB ports add a practical touch for passengers in the back, and body-colored splash guards with carpeted floor and trunk mats show that attention to detail carries over to every corner of this vehicle. The split folding rear seat expands cargo versatility when you need it most, and a rear seat center armrest adds everyday comfort on longer rides.  Technology and convenience are well represented throughout the cabin. The AM/FM/SiriusXM audio system with six speakers and an auxiliary input fills the interior with clean, crisp sound, and steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your hands where they belong. An exterior rear parking camera aids in tighter spots  a feature well appreciated in Bergen County's busy lots and street parking. Speed control, remote keyless entry, a security system, automatic headlights, a tilt and telescoping steering wheel, and an outside temperature display round out a well-equipped daily driver.
